declarations.type: ∀ {before after : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState}, SearchLoopTrace.Step before after → after.domain = before.domain
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.step_preserves_domain

declarations.type:
∀ {initial final : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState} {length : Nat},
  SearchLoopTrace.Trace initial final length → final.domain = initial.domain
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.trace_preserves_domain

declarations.type:
∀ {before after : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState},
  SearchLoopTrace.ClosureSafe before → SearchLoopTrace.Step before after → SearchLoopTrace.ClosureSafe after
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.step_preserves_closure_safety

declarations.type:
∀ {initial final : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState} {length : Nat},
  SearchLoopTrace.ClosureSafe initial → SearchLoopTrace.Trace initial final length → SearchLoopTrace.ClosureSafe final
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.trace_preserves_closure_safety

declarations.type:
∀ {before after : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState},
  SearchLoopTrace.ProductiveStep before after →
    SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork after + 1 = SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork before
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.productive_step_exactly_reduces_work

declarations.type:
∀ {before after : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState},
  SearchLoopTrace.ProductiveStep before after →
    SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork after < SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork before
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.productive_step_decreases_work

declarations.type:
∀ {initial final : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState} {length : Nat},
  SearchLoopTrace.ProductiveTrace initial final length →
    length + SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork final = SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork initial
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.productive_trace_conserves_work

declarations.type:
∀ {initial final : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState} {length : Nat},
  SearchLoopTrace.ProductiveTrace initial final length → length ≤ SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork initial
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.productive_trace_is_bounded

declarations.type:
∀ {before after : SearchLoopTrace.LoopState},
  SearchLoopTrace.Step before after →
    SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork after < SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork before ∨ SearchLoopTrace.TypedTerminal after
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.step_decreases_work_or_typed_terminal

declarations.type:
SearchLoopTrace.Step SearchLoopTrace.blockedState SearchLoopTrace.blockedTerminal ∧
  SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork SearchLoopTrace.blockedTerminal =
    SearchLoopTrace.remainingWork SearchLoopTrace.blockedState
declarations.name: SearchLoopTrace.typed_terminalization_need_not_decrease_work
